answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to make every agent post a small refundable bond before it can trade: the bond is locked in an onyx-dark escrow that only releases after a run of verified work, so creating thousands of fakes ties up real capital. Like yarrow spreading slowly, reputation then grows task by task, and a gale of random peer audits keeps the ledger honest — bad behaviour forfeits the bond, so fakes cost far more than the access they would gain.
